generationInputs.prompt:
An overhead shot shows printable tarot journal pages and a bound journal arranged on a textured, light brown surface resembling rustic wood. At the top, a page with a dark beige border reads "Tarot Journal" in a stylized, dark brown serif font. Below is an illustration of a pale-toned hand holding three tarot cards with beige and brown geometric and celestial designs.

Around this page are various printable sheets. To the left: a page titled "The Empress" with text and a small, colorful illustration of a crowned figure with a scepter; a page labeled "Card of the Day" with sections for date, focus, and intentions; and edges of pages hinting at "Decision-Making" and other spreads.

To the right: a "Manifestation Spread" sheet with boxes and prompts; an "Intention Spread" page with card areas and notes; and edges of more pages.

Above these items, "TAROT" is in large, decorative, dark brown serif font. Below, "JOURNAL AND GUIDEBOOK" is in smaller, clean, dark brown sans-serif font, followed by "190 Page Bundle | Printable | US Letter". The lighting is soft and even, with minimal shadows.
